visual_requirements.description: Youthful beautiful female, exactly four hands/arms holding water pot and pink lotus, blessing gesture and coins; fully opaque white clothes.
Shower real coins into foreground and arise on lotus from churned milky sea.
Primeval milky ocean and large lotus.

depicted_variant: Four-armed white-clothed Lakshmi arising on a pink lotus and showering prosperity.
aura: Coin shower(c16) and lotus emergence from milky ocean(c03,c21) visibly embody abundance without generic glow.
artistic_choices: Youthful rounded cheekbones with dignified raised brow differ from Hestia angular face.
White clothing fully opaque even at wave edges; jewelry editorial.
Low close camera provides imposing sacred majesty without inventing bodily scale.
Blessing is a gentle angled downward gesture, not repetitive stop palm toward camera.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Lakshmi, revered benevolent Hindu goddess of prosperity arising from the milky ocean.
ANATOMY: youthful beautiful Indian female, soft rounded cheekbones, dignified resolute gaze, exactly ONE head TWO eyes FOUR arms FOUR hands TWO legs. Fully opaque white sari and white blouse completely cover torso/chest and legs, gold jewelry. One upper hand holds ONE pink lotus, other upper hand holds water pot; one lower hand gives gentle angled-down blessing and other lower hand pours real gold coins [lakshmi-c01,c09,c16].
POWER: real uninscribed coins shower outward/downward, lotus rises out of churned milky waves, no aura [lakshmi-c03,c16,c21].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle at lotus petals, goddess and all FOUR arm attachments legible, no extra hands, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single strong low sunset behind sea clouds, warm gold rim and deep pearl shadows, physical white sea spray.
SURFACE: thick opaque white woven fabric, antique gold jewelry, wet pink lotus petals.
SETTING: primeval milky ocean with open lotus supporting goddess [lakshmi-c03,c16,c21].
MOOD: sacred generous overwhelming majesty, respectful never monstrous or malevolent, never ordinary decorative fashion portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/pseudo-script anywhere including coins/pot/cloth, no logos/frames/watermarks, no extra heads or limbs; EXACTLY FOUR ARMS EACH anatomically separate, no film/game/anime, no nudity/transparent clothes, no gore, no aura/neon/ribbons.
MOMENT: Lakshmi rises from the sea on the swelling open lotus, foreground coins tumble toward camera from lower hand, face commanding above; upper lotus and pot symmetrically legible, blessing hand angled toward coins. Front three-quarter close view.
